jobs.backend_py: We need a backend engineer with Python and Docker experience. Knowledge of PostgreSQL is a plus. The role involves building REST APIs and working with a CI pipeline.
jobs.dotnet: We are hiring a .NET backend engineer. Required: C# and .NET, SQL, building REST APIs and Git. Azure experience is a plus. You will work in a small team and write unit tests.

cases.name: Normal 1 (strong, Python)
cases.profile: Backend engineer with five years of experience. Designs REST APIs in Python, stores data in PostgreSQL, ships with Docker and tests with pytest. Runs CI on GitHub Actions.
